prompt_text: Who is the best healthcare marketing agency in St. Louis?
answer_verbatim:
There’s no single objectively “best” healthcare marketing agency in St. Louis — the right agency depends on your organization, goals, budget, and the services you need. I can help you find the best fit. A few quick questions will let me give a targeted shortlist:

- What type of healthcare organization are you (hospital/health system, medical practice, clinic, med‑tech/device, payer, biotech, startup)?  
- Which services do you need (brand strategy, digital marketing/SEO, paid media, content, physician/patient acquisition, PR, creative, marketing technology)?  
- Budget range and timeline?  
- Geographic scope (local St. Louis patients only, regional, national)?  
- Any examples of marketing you like or KPIs you must hit?

If you want to look yourself or evaluate proposals, here’s a practical approach and checklist:

How to find candidates
- Search Clutch, UpCity, DesignRush and Google for “healthcare marketing agency St. Louis.”  
- Check local sources: St. Louis Business Journal, AMA St. Louis chapter, LinkedIn, referrals from peers.  
- Look for agencies with HIPAA-aware processes and experience with healthcare regulations.

Selection criteria
- Relevant healthcare experience (similar org type & campaign goals).  
- Measurable results and case studies (patient acquisition, lead gen, ROAS, SEO ranking improvements).  
- Team capabilities (strategy, creative, analytics, compliance/legal review).  
- Marketing technology and reporting (CRM integration, attribution, dashboards).  
- Compliance knowledge (HIPAA, PHI handling, healthcare advertising rules).  
- Client references and retention rate.  
- Culture fit and communication cadence.

Interview / RFP questions
- Which healthcare clients do you currently serve and what were the results?  
- How do you handle PHI and compliance in campaigns?  
- Can you show campaign KPIs and a reporting example?  
- Who will be on our account and what are their roles?  
- How do you measure and attribute patient acquisition?  
- Typical timelines and cost structure (retainer/project/percentage of ad spend)?

If you want, tell me the answers to those questions above and I’ll build a short list of St. Louis agencies that match your needs and a recommended scoring sheet for evaluating proposals.
